mapper.insert: INSERT INTO handout_run_metrics (run_id, task_id, workflow_code, result_status, submitted_at, enqueued_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{runId}, #{taskId}, 'handout', 'QUEUED', #{submittedAt}, #{enqueuedAt}, #{enqueuedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE submitted_at=COALESCE(submitted_at, VALUES(submitted_at)), enqueued_at=COALESCE(enqueued_at, VALUES(enqueued_at)), updated_at=VALUES(updated_at)

INSERT INTO handout_run_metrics (run_id, task_id, workflow_code, result_status, claimed_at, queue_wait_ms, retry_count, updated_at) VALUES (#{runId}, #{taskId}, 'handout', #{status}, #{claimedAt}, #{queueWaitMs}, #{retryCount}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE result_status=VALUES(result_status), claimed_at=VALUES(claimed_at), queue_wait_ms=VALUES(queue_wait_ms), retry_count=GREATEST(COALESCE(retry_count, 0), VALUES(retry_count)), updated_at=VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE handout_run_metrics SET xelatex_started_at=#{xelatexStartedAt}, pdf_elapsed_ms=#{elapsedMs}, updated_at=COALESCE(#{xelatexStartedAt}, updated_at) WHERE run_id=#{runId}
